scope: Bind one additional implicit compiler input for controlled semantic-adapter builds without promoting compile-contract eligibility.

implementation.capture: For Clang/AppleClang POSIX profiles, query the configured compiler with --no-default-config -print-resource-dir; deterministically hash directory/file entries, file bytes, modes, and symlink targets; recheck after build. Enforce 100000-entry and 2-GiB capture budgets. Other profiles record unavailable.
implementation.pairPolicy: The compiler resource identity participates in target/standalone build parity. A change on either side rejects the pair. Existing older receipt shapes remain accepted for replay.
